user.title: Add an HA Watcher
user.description: This creates a private web address (a webhook) that your ha-watcher service sends its status to. The ha-watcher service must run on a different machine from Home Assistant. You will see the address after you press Submit.

data.name: Name
data.local_only: Only accept reports from the local network

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, for example the name of the machine running ha-watcher.
data_description.local_only: Recommended. Turn off only if the watcher reaches Home Assistant over the internet.

create_entry.default:
Copy this address into the `home_assistant_push.url` setting of your ha-watcher service:

`{webhook_url}`

Keep it private: anyone who knows it can send status reports. You can see it again under this integration's **Configure** button.

init.title: HA Watcher options
init.description:

data.local_only: Only accept reports from the local network

data_description.offline_timeout: Mark the watcher offline when no valid report has arrived for this many minutes. Use at least twice the watcher's report interval.
